card.name: Punctuation near antifolate and transporter drugs
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and partial words right next to methotrexate, pemetrexed, fluorouracil or transporter names (BCRP, OATP, OAT1) in interaction lists. It fires on the comma, bracket or number just before or after the drug name.

modes.label: Commas in drug lists
modes.description: A comma or 'e.g.,' right after a drug name in a list of example interacting drugs, often methotrexate.

modes.label: Opening bracket before a drug
modes.description: A bracket or space just before an inhibitor drug name or a unit exponent.

card.plain: It marks the punctuation around methotrexate-type chemotherapy and transporter drug interaction lists.
